notes: The restaurant chain site (Angular, robots allow) states in its meta description it operates in Алматы, Астана, Шымкент and Караганда and 'Работаем с 12:00 до 00:00' — chain-wide schedule kept raw (needs_days, 00:00 close). Its JSON-LD Restaurant card carries the Алматинский address (пр-т Абая, 157А) only; /contacts and /menu render city lists client-side and print no Astana street address — so no address stored; the hotline numbers (+7 771 709 99 00, +7 (777) 777-77-77) are chain-wide, not per-branch.
